spec.prompt_text: The maintenance record lists robot sensors, inspection dates and replacement parts.
spec.hypothesis: Short-budget admission can reduce mean arrival-to-first-token without unacceptable p95 completion, throughput or allocator peak regression.
spec.primary: Per-trace median of 5 round mean arrival-to-first-token; each trace must pass all acceptance gates.
spec.clock: Independent producer records scheduled and actual arrival. Queue=dispatch-actual; TTFT=first-token-actual; total=post-final-sync-actual; TPOT=(last-first)/(n-1).
spec.timing: Actual wall-clock producer and native generation. Includes queue, private cache creation, native sampling/prefetch and synchronization. Excludes weight loading, tokenization, network. Receipt serialization occurs after each complete trace; interrupted trace retained on failure. Timing does not include receipt serialization.
spec.reference: Same pinned MLX-LM native generate_step fresh-cache path; FCFS admission. Not a serving-framework throughput comparison.
spec.correctness: 12 full-vocabulary repeat comparisons before timing, token equality on every timed request; stop on any mismatch, nonfinite or budget failure. Arrays transient; hashes and checks archived.
spec.lifecycle: Real generator close after token3 and injected consumer exception after token3; synchronize prefetched work then release cache; subsequent fresh-request tokens must match. No asynchronous GPU cancellation or backend-failure recovery claim.
spec.bounds: Single worker non-preemptive inference; independent submission thread and actual queue. No continuous batching, concurrent GPU requests, quality evaluation, training, CUDA/Ascend, SLA or production deployment. Score uses known input/output budgets, never measured future time. 12 requests per trace give descriptive p95 only; no population-tail inference. All trials retained; no retry/retune.
spec.output: results/qwen-request-scheduling-v1; must not exist; partial in-progress receipt preserved on failure
